generic:label: class labels in fit and holdout are wrong
disagree with movie_time_s (stimulus log

data_issues: (1) stim_class labels in fit and holdout are wrong: they disagree with movie_time_s (stimulus log) on every trial by a consistent cyclic shift (given stim_class = (movie_time_s-80+4) mod 6, e.g. 80 s labeled 4, 82 s labeled 0); I retrained on labels rederived from movie_time_s. (2) The unit (column) order in eval.npz is permuted relative to fit/holdout: per-unit firing rates do not match column-wise (e.g. the ~8 spk/bin unit is column 13 in fit but column 0 in eval). I recovered the mapping by matching rate statistics and maximizing Poisson-mixture likelihood (eval column for each train unit: [14, 13, 2, 3, 5, 16, 6, 4, 8, 12, 10, 7, 11, 0, 9, 15, 1, 17]), which gave a balanced 3 trials/class.
